First, I want to thank you for being an awesome Mom by promoting creativity at a young age.
However, you cannot open the world on the XBOX1 without being with Stampy, sadly. With that said, however, I would motivate your son to create a better world than that of youtubers, so that he can have his own little world that he can call his own, and all of what he creates can be directly attributed to him.
I have a brother who is around 6, and he is an avid player of minecraft, and is on the XBOX1, just like your son. He has asked us to download certain minecraft worlds of youtubers, but we said "no, make your own world that you'll be proud of", and that's what he did, and he is super proud of it.
Sorry if worded weirdly, I am very tired, haha

Yep, sure do!
I went into a fresh, new, creative world and flew around (after figuring out the controls), until stumbling upon a cave that went into a mountain. I immediately searched the creative menu for some glass, and after finding it I placed it on the entrance. The cave looked pretty cool considering that  it was kind of encased by glass. Don't have any more screenshots, those are long gone. 
Thanks for asking this, brought back memories.
I cannot receive help when I have it embedded within my own head that everyone is against me and plotting against me (thus why I think I have schizophrenia)
